mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may lower seizure threshold and reduce praziquantel efficacy; praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4 may be affected by torsemide-induced changes in hepatic perfusion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain potassium and magnesium levels, and consider alternative diuretics if parasitic disease control is suboptimal.
